text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, after winning countless races together with Copano Rickey—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!!
Trainer, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Rickeyâ Luckyâ Hot Springs Tour!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Out of nowhere...? Not quite, right?
I've been looking forward to this the whole time.
Ever since the day I won those hot spring tickets in the lottery♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"The time has come! The weather is great!
If I head to the hot springs in the auspicious direction right now, I'll absorb a ton of good luck☆"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: So let's go! Hurry, hurry♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With minimal preparation, we headed off to the hot springs resort.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that bath felt nice.
Though I might have stayed in a bit too long...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
From a feng shui standpoint, this is totally fine!
In fact, it might even boost our luck!
choice_data_list: Is there a Feng Shui way to get into a hot spring too?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'll make sure to
teach you all about it too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Since we came here together, let's put it into practice
a lot and become the happiest we can be♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I gratefully decided to learn their ways.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
First, in the open-air bath, stand barefoot.
And make sure to feel the breeze properly.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: And if there's drinkable hot spring water, you should definitely have some♪ It helps build up your qi.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And as for food, next is to eat
the local specialties of the area☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"With the power of hot springs and fortune-boosting rituals,
our luck is gonna skyrocket!"
choice_data_list: Alright, let's order the special dish too!
Alright, let's order the special dish too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After sharing a toast, we ate plenty of dishes made with
an abundance of local ingredients. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Chirp chirp... chirp...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A morning bath when you wake up! Face east,
bask in plenty of sunlight, and—...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Your fortune is looking great☆ Yep, yep!
You're shining so bright you look like a totally different person, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Copano Rickey hypes me up like that,
I really start to feel that way.
It was a trip that got my spirits soaring to the absolute max.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
With this, our various fortunes have gone up!♪
Financial luck especially went up a ton, so at this rate...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I might end up getting something really nice in the future. For example...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: No, even more than that! For example—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Like a luxury condo apartment, maybe?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My dreams have expanded...
A spacious floor plan, antique furniture,
and the absolute best view...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The hot springs trip alone was luxurious enough, but
on top of that, I got to have an unimaginably wonderful dream.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You were smirking a little just now♪
Well? Did you picture our future together?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether it would come true was a different story.
Even so, it felt truly exquisite.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If this trip brought happiness to the Trainer
who's always taking care of me,
then I'm happy too! âª

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well then, after our morning bath, let's go for a walk.
The greenery looks lovely, Trainer☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A wonderful hot spring trip
where you can enjoy all kinds of fresh delights...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable bond
with Copano Rickey...
